mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward movement in the unemployment rate above 3.0 percentage points triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when UNRATE crosses above 3.0pp, or IC < 0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and growth in economic demand (measured by GDPC1) creates a favorable monetary and demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both conditions are met, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant increases in supply growth (INDPRO) and labor participation (PAYEMS) signal a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both proxies rise, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward movement in the CPIAUCSL index indicates rising inflation expectations, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not negative when CPIAUCSL rises, or IC > 0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in economic demand (measured by GDPC1) signals strong consumer and business activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive despite GDPC1 growth, or IC < 0.1 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate coupled with rising demand for goods (RSAFS) creates a favorable monetary and demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both conditions are met, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 2.0% during contractionary phases signals labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive when UNRATE drops below 2.0%, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.
